statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope
There is concern for intermittent arrhythmia
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary for this patient
